subject: AegisBank MAP: security alignment, evidence lanes, and close timeline
messages:
From: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@aegisbank.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: tom.rivers@aegisbank.com
Date: 2026-06-01T09:14:00Z
Subject: Initial MAP and security intake

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our security team has asked for a short mutual action plan (MAP) that shows: SOC 2 evidence timing, SIG/CAIQ responses, DPA redline cadence, and proposed data retention/residency for EU and US accounts.

Can you share a MAP template with lanes for security owners and target close dates? We have a hard procurement deadline for our Q3 rollout (target sign-off by 2026-07-15). Also: we need to confirm whether Redwood can support a 90-day log retention window for tokenized request traces, and an EU-only residency option for cardholder data handling.

Appreciate it —
Sophie
Security Program Manager
AegisBank

Attachment: none in this initial note

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@aegisbank.com>, Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@aegisbank.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-02T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial MAP and security intake

Hi Sophie —

Thanks — attached is a draft MAP (AegisBank-MAP-v1.2.xlsx) that breaks the work into three lanes: Security (SOC 2 evidence + SIG/CAIQ), Legal/Procurement (DPA redlines + SOW), and Engineering (data residency/retention + deployment plan). High level notes: 

- SOC 2: Redwood will provide our SOC 2 Type II report and evidence package. We can commit to a SOC 2 evidence delivery window of 7 business days after your evidence request list is finalized.
- SIG/CAIQ: We completed a CAIQ export for common controls; items that require customer-specific configs are flagged in the SIG-CAIQ sheet. We propose a 10-business-day review loop with your security SMEs.
- DPA/redlines: Neha will own the redline cadence. We can turn around DPA comments within 3 business days for non-substantive items; for new carve-outs we will need to escalate to Legal (target 7 business days).
- Data retention/residency: For production tokenized traces we support configurable retention windows; default 180 days. EU-only residency is available on Redwood Private (we will set up a dedicated region/tenant). We can support 90-day retention for request traces as a configurable profile — this will change backup/snapshot SLA and requires a brief security review.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Sophie/Tom: mark required evidence items in column "Aegis Required" in the attached MAP (by 2026-06-05).
2) Security sync: schedule 30-min call w/ Jonas + your security lead to walk the SIG flags (aim for week of 2026-06-08).
3) DPA kickoff: Neha will put a redline tracker in Drive and send initial comments by 2026-06-07.

I attached: AegisBank-MAP-v1.2.xlsx (MAP with evidence lanes), SIG-CAIQ-gap-summary.xlsx, and DPA_redlines_Aegis_vGRACE.pdf (initial comments).

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachments: AegisBank-MAP-v1.2.xlsx (MAP), SIG-CAIQ-gap-summary.xlsx (SIG export), DPA_redlines_Aegis_vGRACE.pdf (redline snapshot)

From: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@aegisbank.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@aegisbank.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T08:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial MAP and security intake

Grace/Sophie —

Quick clarifications from Aegis security: 
- The 90-day retention is preferred for request traces; however, we need confirmation on whether archived logs (for audit) will be retained for at least 2 years in read-only storage. If Redwood can export an immutable archive to our S3 with AES-256, that satisfies audit needs.
- For SIG: we care about the controls in CAIQ domains CC, IA, and SA. We'll highlight 15 high-priority questions in the MAP by Friday.

Let's take the walk-through with Jonas on Monday. Do you have availability 2026-06-08 11:00 AM ET?

Regards,
Tom
Head of Cloud Security, AegisBank

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@aegisbank.com>, Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@aegisbank.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-04T15:42:00Z
Subject: RE: Initial MAP and security intake — walk-through notes and next milestones

Hi Tom/Sophie — thanks for the questions. Recap from today's 30-min sync and agreed milestones: 

1) Evidence handover (SOC 2): Redwood will upload the SOC 2 report and evidence index to the shared Drive folder by 2026-06-05 EOD. Aegis will confirm which evidence items they need for procurement by 2026-06-09.

2) SIG/CAIQ deep-dive: You flagged 15 high-priority CAIQ items (domains CC/IA/SA). Redwood will annotate the SIG-CAIQ sheet with control owners and any compensating controls by 2026-06-09. If any control requires engineering changes (e.g., additional logging for IA-5), we will scope remediation and include it in the MAP with an owner and ETA.

3) DPA cadence: Neha will publish the DPA redline tracker and send an initial proposed compromise for the logging retention clause (Section 4.2) by 2026-06-07. Proposed compromise: default 180-day retention, exportable immutable archive to customer S3 for 24 months on request (with associated egress fee).

4) Data residency & retention profile:
- EU residency option: available under Redwood Private; planning and provisioning lead time estimated at 4 weeks from contract signature.
- 90-day retention profile: we can create a non-default profile; will require a brief security review and an update to backup policy (target completion 2026-06-18).

5) Close timeline: Aligning with your Q3 procurement target (2026-07-15), tentative MAP milestones are: evidence sign-off 2026-06-16, DPA agreed redlines 2026-06-23, final SOW/PO 2026-07-08, contract execution 2026-07-15. We'll update the MAP spreadsheet with these dates.

Action items: 
- Sophie/Tom: finalize the Aegis required evidence columns in the MAP (deadline 2026-06-09).
- Neha: publish DPA redline tracker (deadline 2026-06-07).
- Jonas: annotated SIG sheet and remediation queue (deadline 2026-06-09).

If you want the timeline tightened we can propose a 2-week acceleration package (dedicated onboarding resources + SLA addendum) — happy to scope if you indicate interest.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
